description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Metallic Mimic
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat

uses.name: Metallic Mimic
uses.cardState: with a type chosen that matches a type of the persist creature
